Meerut Court Sentences Couple to Death in 'Blue Drum' Murder Case

A court in Meerut has sentenced Muskan Rastogi and her partner Sahil Shukla to death for the murder of her husband, Saurabh Rajput. The victim's body was found dismembered and cemented inside a blue drum. The trial lasted 13 months and involved 126 hearings. Police reportedly used a hammer and chisel to break open the cement-filled drum. Saurabh Rajput's mother expressed satisfaction with the verdict.
